[EN] The power of Lok's corruption is astonishing. That it should persist decades after his death is unusual.

Perhaps we can harness that power to undo the corruption and shape Blightwood into something more to our liking.
[ES] El poder de la corrupción de Lok es asombroso. Que persista décadas después de su muerte es inusual.

Tal vez podamos aprovechar ese poder para deshacer la corrupción y convertir Blightwood en algo más de nuestro agrado.
